sourceReferencePolicy: Farm-a, grass-main-a and path-strip-a inspected visually; new-generation calls omit referenced_image_paths as required by tool. Style cues described in each prompt.

toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent vegetation sprite for a warm painterly mobile farming game, matched to a cheerful farm with lush yellow-green meadow, clover and sandy ochre paths.
Style: softly painted rounded organic forms, warm saturated natural colours, friendly compact shapes, no black outlines. Readable as a SMALL game sprite: broad leaves and clear grouped shapes, restrained detail, no tiny decorative clutter or photoreal microtexture.
Camera: orthographic 3/4 view from the south, 52 degrees above the horizon, looking DOWN at the plant. Clearly show the TOP surfaces and depth of the leaf clusters; foreshorten the vertical stems. This is an elevated game-camera plant view.
Lighting: soft warm sunlight from the lower-left of the image; softly darker upper-right-facing surfaces, no cast shadow outside the plant.
Composition: a single complete isolated plant group, square canvas with actual transparent RGBA background. Ground-contact base centered at x=50% very near the bottom edge, all leaves and flowers fully inside the canvas with a small safety margin. No soil disk, ground patch, pot, pedestal, frame, text, watermark, or background; no baked drop shadow. Keep the contact base narrow and unmistakable.
Palette: meadow yellow-green and warm olive foliage, lime-gold highlights, natural deeper olive in leaf overlaps; no cyan or blue-green foliage.

Subject: A short compact tuft of fresh meadow grass, a few broad curved blades in a rounded fan and exactly two small cream-white daisy flowers with golden centres, low among the leaves. Upright central blades and lower outward side blades. Grass is the main subject.
Final in-game asset size: 256 by 256 pixels after technical downsampling; design the silhouette and detail for that scale.
